names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 18 decembrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Sebastian», with the rank words left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιος Σεβαστιανός», with the rank word left off. The page glosses the name itself, «(από την λέξη σεβαστός) = ο αξιοσέβαστος».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s first heading for 18. децембар ст. ст., „Свети мученик Севастијан и други с њим.“ — with «Свети» left off, which §5 says is not a rank, «мученик» left off, that being the `martyr` grade §5 maps and `types` keeps, and «и други с њим» left off, that being a company tail and not part of anybody’s name. The bare forename is what is left. THE FOLD WAS MEASURED BEFORE THE FORM WAS WRITTEN: `fk.mjs` puts the key `севастијан` at NO other holder, so no READ_FOLDS key is written — and that is in spite of the corpus holding four other Sebastian folders, of Cartagena, of Posesone, of Karaganda and Sebastian Dabovic, none of which carries a Serbian form.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (28 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 18 decembrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Sebastian»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιος Σεβαστιανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: the commander of the praetorians under Diocletian who declared himself a Christian to hearten the Christians on trial. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. **The two sources disagree about where he was born and the folder's life is left standing:** doxologia has him born at Narbonne and brought up and schooled at Milan; saint.gr has him «γεννήθηκε στα Μεδιόλανα της Ιταλίας, το 250 με 256 μ.Χ.», born at Mediolanum itself. That is for the author to rule on. **The years are added to a folder that held none:** the birth from «το 250 με 256 μ.Χ.» and the death from the page head «(; - 287)». saint.gr adds the emperor Carinus's favour, Diocletian's making him head of the first regiment of the praetorians, the title of defender of the Church given him by pope Gaius, the arrow in the chest, the pious widow Lucina who took the body and found him still breathing and nursed him back, and his going again to Diocletian to rebuke him for his cruelty, for which he was scourged to death. No coordinate is proposed. **The same day page keeps the ten of his company by name, «Άγιοι Νικόστρατος, Ζωή η σύζυγός του, Τραγκυλίνος και η σύζυγός του Μαρκία, Κλαύδιος, Τιβούρτιος, Κάστωρ, Καστούλος, Μάρκος και Μαρκελλίνος», who are drafted as nine new folders in `el-12-18-1` with Zoe's row in this file.** It prints one apolytikion, which names him, and that is taken.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 31.12.2025 (18. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Севастијан и други с њим.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. The third calendar to keep him on this menologion day. **THE HEADING’S TAIL, «и други с њим», IS WHY SEVEN OTHER FOLDERS TAKE A ROW IN THIS SAME COMMIT, and the ruling is written out in full here.** It names and counts nobody, which on the Julian 12-14 made a previous reader write nothing for the others; but its words DESCRIBE a class — others who suffered with him — and the body then names them one by one, and the corpus already keeps every one of them on this same menologion 18/12 from the Greek and the Romanian. That is the 12-08 case, where „Свети мученици у Африци.“ gave rows to the three groups its body counted, and not the 12-04 case, where Barbara’s heading named Barbara alone and described Juliana not at all. The seven given rows are `marcus-son-of-tranquillinus`, `marcellinus-son-of-tranquillinus`, `zoe-18-december`, `nicostratus-18-december`, `claudius-18-december`, `tranquillinus` and `tiburtius-18-december`; they are all ten of this folder’s existing `related` rows less `marcia-wife-of-tranquillinus`, `castor-18-december` and `castulus-18-december`, whom THIS BOOK DOES NOT NAME. AUTHOR QUESTION. `types` UNTOUCHED: `martyr` and `soldier` are held and both are this book’s words — «преда се служби војничкој», he gave himself to military service, and the martyrdom is the whole entry. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND THE DEATH NOW AGREED BY A THIRD BOOK: the folder’s 287 came from saint.gr’s page head, and this book states it in a sentence — «пресели се у Царство небеско 287. године у време Диоклецијана цара, и Гаја, епископа римског». **A THIRD READING OF HIS BIRTHPLACE, recorded and not resolved**: saint.gr has him born at Mediolanum, doxologia.ro at Narbonne with only his schooling at Milan, and this book says «роди се у Италији и би васпитан у граду Милану» — born in Italy and brought up in the city of Milan, which keeps doxologia’s shape and names no town for the birth. The `birth` bounds of 250 to 256 are saint.gr’s and were not moved, this book giving no year for it. NO `locations`: Italy, Milan and Rome are three places and the folder has never held a coordinate. NO NEW `related` ROW: all ten companions were here already, and «Гај, епископ римског», whom the book names only to date the death, is `gaius-pope-of-rome` — a DATING REFERENCE and not a companion, which is why his name is in this row and NOT in the life: that folder’s whole display name is the bare «Gaius», and writing it unlinked in prose would demand a reverse `related` row this entry does not justify. Chromatius the eparch of Rome, whom this book has healed of gout and baptised with his son Tiburtius, IS NAMED IN THE BODY AND HAS NO FOLDER; he was left out and is in the report. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS: the secrecy of his faith while he commanded Diocletian’s palace guard; that he saved Christians from torture and death where he could and strengthened them to die where he could not; THE FACE SHINING LIKE AN ANGEL’S as he was confirming Marcus and Marcellinus, which all present saw; the five healings and the households they brought to baptism; the order of the deaths; and his own answer to the emperor’s charge of treason — „Ја се свагда молим Христу моме за здравље твоје и за мир царства Римског“, I pray always to my Christ for your health and for the peace of the Roman empire. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Σεβαστιανός γεννήθηκε στα Μεδιόλανα της Ιταλίας, το 250 με 256 μ.Χ.» The folder held no dates before this reading; **the same sentence puts his birth at Mediolanum, where doxologia's life puts it at Narbonne and only his schooling at Milan, and that disagreement is recorded in the Greek attestation and not resolved.**

death.note: saint.gr's page head, «Αγιος Σεβαστιανος (; - 287)». Its narrative dates nothing: it has Carinus favour him, Diocletian make him head of the praetorians and order his death, and after Lucina nursed him back it has him scourged to death, with no year for any of it.

hymns.text: Συγκλήτου σφαλλομένης παριδῶν τὰ συνέδρια, Σεβαστιανὲ πανολβίαν, συναγείρεις συνέλευσιν, Μαρτύρων ἀληθῶς πανευκλεῶν, σὺν σοῖ καταβαλόντων τὸν ἐχθρόν, μεθ' ὧν θείας συναυλίας ἀξιωθεῖς, φαιδρύνεις τοὺς βοώντας σοι, δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργούντι διὰ σοῦ, πάσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης, on the page of Άγιος Σεβαστιανός. It names him, and the assembly of martyrs it says he gathered is the company the same day keeps with him.

english.text: Overlooking the councils of a Senate that went astray, O Sebastian, you gather an all-blessed assembly of martyrs truly most glorious, who cast down the enemy together with you; counted worthy of the divine fellowship with them, you gladden those who cry to you: glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who works healings for all through you.
